messages:
maya: uploaded PR #4238 — metering onboarding + SDK header snippet for customers. PTAL, focus areas: header name, migration note, and the dashboard mapping example. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4238 :eyes:
kevin: thanks — quick q: are we changing the header name? legacy clients expect X-Redwood-Metering so we should document fallback behavior.
maya: good point. current snippet uses `X-RW-Metering: v2` but I added a migration section showing the fallback to `X-Redwood-Metering`. see curl + python example below.
kevin: nice. can you add a short table showing server-side interpretation of both headers? helps SREs.
jordan: small nit on the python snippet — using `client.headers` is ambiguous, should show `client._default_headers` or use the SDK helper `set_metering_header()` in the example. keeps it clear for readers.
maya: updated — switched to helper API and added explicit fallback logic. new snippet:
```bash
# curl example for v2 header
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY" -H "X-RW-Metering: {\"account_id\":\"acct_123\",\"tier\":\"team\"}" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
```python
# python SDK example (recommended)
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RW_KEY")
client.set_metering_header(account_id="acct_123", tier="team")
resp = client.embeddings.create(input=["hi"])
```
sasha: I'll run the curl and SDK snippet in staging and confirm the metering labels show up in the usage pipeline (plan_tier & metering_source). I'll also grab a dashboard screenshot to include.
docs-ci: deploy preview created at https://deploy-preview-4238--docs.redwood.ai — build 117 passed.
kevin: thanks — add the table mapping HTTP header fields -> telemetry labels (e.g., `tier` -> `plan_tier`, `account_id` -> `customer_id`). This will reduce support tickets.
maya: added the mapping table and a short troubleshooting section for common 401/400s with examples of the header payload shape.
jordan: LGTM aside from one tiny wording tweak in the troubleshooting step 2.
sasha: screenshot uploaded and I updated the dashboard panel id in the doc (`/dashboards/usage-metering/` -> `/dashboards/metering-onboarding/`). verified metrics show sample event with plan_tier=team.
maya: thanks all — running final checks, will merge once docs-ci green. :shipit:
docs-ci: all checks passed.
ops-bot: merged branch docs/pr/4238 into main by maya at 2945678918
maya: merged and backfilled redirect for old header link. leaving a follow-up task for analytic team to backfill historic events for the first day of migration. :calendar:
